messages:
Alicia: Heads-up — noticed playbook priority fanout doubled sample size after last deploy, a few accounts got duplicate nudges.
Ben: ah thanks, saw a spike in run_count today, didn't correlate yet. link to dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/playbook-fanout
Maria: Impact? any renewals at risk or mostly noise?
Alicia: mostly noise. ~650 extra nudges across mid-market cohort, but 12 accounts flagged as 'escalate' because they hit engagement threshold twice.
Kyle: ran quick query, looks like the fanout multiplier cfg got set to 2 instead of 1 for priority buckets; snippet from audit log: `config.set("playbook.priority_fanout", 2) by deploy-user`
Nora: those 12 'escalate' accounts include 3 in onboarding week 1 — we shouldn't double-escalate them.
Ben: rolling a hotfix to revert multiplier to 1.0 now, will run in staging then prod canary. ETA 20m.
ops-bot: deploy queued — diff: `-priority_fanout: 2 -> +priority_fanout: 1` — triggered by Ben — will canary in us-west-2.
Maria: good. After hotfix, can we run a targeted remediation to remove duplicate nudges for affected accounts? want to avoid noise and preserve CS trust.
Alicia: yes. proposal: backfill script to dedupe nudges created in the window 2025-02-03 09:00-11:15 UTC and mark duplicate events as suppressed. dry-run first.
Kyle: I can produce the account list and sample payloads. query: `select account_id, count(*) as nudges from playbook_runs where created_at between '2025-02-03 09:00' and '2025-02-03 11:15' group by account_id having nudges > 1 limit 100`
Ben: for safety, the remediation should only touch nudges with source = 'playbook.priority' and status = 'queued' or 'sent' but not 'acknowledged'.
Nora: also need to notify owners before suppression. we have owners for those 12 accounts, i'll ping them after we have list.
Maria: ops checklist: 1) confirm hotfix in canary 2) prod deploy 3) generate dup list 4) dry-run suppression in staging 5) run remediation with owner pings 6) add telemetry alert to prevent silent fanout regressions. assign tasks?
Alicia: I'll own steps 3-5. Ben owns 1-2. Kyle will produce datasets. Nora will handle owner pings. Maria will sign off and file postmortem.
Ben: canary went green, rolling to prod now.
ops-bot: deploy succeeded in canary, starting prod rollout (2/3 hosts).
Ben: prod done on 2/3 and finishing. Confirmed config reverted.
Kyle: attached account sample csv (dry-run) and the query results: 12 accounts with dup_nudges counts 2-4.
Alicia: ran staging suppression dry-run, no collateral changed. will schedule prod remediation in 30 minutes and include owner ping template.
Nora: owner ping template preview: "Hey <owner>, we detected duplicate playbook nudges to <account>. We will suppress duplicates and you may see one fewer automated nudge. Reply if you want us to pause suppression."
Maria: good template. please include link to account view and contact information.
Alicia: remediation executed, suppressed 638 duplicate nudges, flagged 12 accounts for manual review. created incident note and flagged for postmortem.
Ben: thanks team. action item: add unit/regression test to deployment pipeline to validate priority_fanout stays within [0.5,1.5] for prod releases.
Kyle: will add alert query and a 1-hour rolling window metric to PagerDuty rule.
Maria: assign owner to postmortem doc and include timeline + customer reachout plan. Alicia, can you draft?
Alicia: yes will draft and share in #customer-success-postmortems. :memo:
Nora: thanks — owners notified. most replied OK. one asked for a short summary for the account exec, will send.
Maria: closing notes: prioritize preventing silent config drift. recommend adding an immutable deploy tag for playbook-critical configs.
Alicia: noted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
